faqs.a:
The rights and remedies hereinbefore given the taxpayer and the property owner for
               objecting to, contesting or appealing from the amount, correctness, regularity or
               validity of such new assessment or reassessment are hereby declared to be exclusive
               of all other rights, remedies, suits or actions either at law or in equity which might
               otherwise be available and to afford him a sufficient day in court for the redressing
               of all rights and grievances that he may have in connection with such new assessment
               or reassessment.
(Code 1981, § 27-145; Ord. No. 551, § 86, 5-14-1964)
